subject: Customer data purge: prompts, outputs, and access logs — StitchPay request
messages:
From: Andrea Liu <andrea@stitchpay.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@stitchpay.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompts, outputs, and access logs (account ST-9182)

Hi Diego,

We need Redwood to execute an account-level purge for StitchPay account ST-9182. Scope: all user-supplied prompts, generated outputs, and the associated access/ingestion logs for the period Jan 1, 2025 -> May 30, 2027. Our legal/compliance team requires: 1) a high-level execution plan, 2) a signed attestation when completed, and 3) evidence (redaction/export logs and a chain-of-custody record).

Can you confirm what you will delete, the retention windows that apply, and an estimated completion ETA? Also please flag any items we need to provide (e.g., exact conversation IDs).

Thanks,
Andrea Liu
Head of Security Ops
StitchPay

--
Andrea Liu
StitchPay
andrea@stitchpay.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Liu <andrea@stitchpay.com>
Cc: Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@stitchpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts, outputs, and access logs (account ST-9182)

Andrea — thanks for the clear ask. We can run a scoped purge covering: (a) prompt text and generated outputs linked to ST-9182, (b) per-request logs (ingestion/log line artifacts and access metadata), and (c) any transient KV/prefix caches tied to that account.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll draft an execution plan and a mutual action checklist (what we will remove vs what you confirm).
- Ops will provide a redaction log and chain-of-custody artifacts after the run.
- We typically need customer-provided conversation IDs only for objects outside normal request indexing — if you can export any long-lived job IDs, include them, otherwise we can detect via account tag.

ETA: preliminary plan in 4 business hours; execution window can be scheduled within 48 hours after sign-off.

Ben — can you and Marissa help run through the operational constraints? I’ll loop in Evelyn to own evidence delivery.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: purge of prompts, outputs, and access logs (account ST-9182)

Diego — quick ops notes:
- There are two storage locations to consider: hot runtime KV cache (short TTL) and cold object store for prompt/output archives. Cold archive deletions are batched and require a ticket for the storage team; that will be the critical path.
- Access logs live in our audit-log cluster; we can export and then redact rows that match ST-9182 identifiers. That produces a redaction-log CSV (timestamp, object_id, action).
- For chain-of-custody we can produce a signed hash manifest plus a time-stamped process log.

I estimate work time: 8–12 engineer-hours total, execution slip up to 72 hours if we need legal to release preserved snapshots.

Marissa — can you confirm if we need any special handling for embeddings or derivative artifacts (we should treat them as generated outputs)?

Ben
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: purge of prompts, outputs, and access logs (account ST-9182)

Ben — yes, treat embeddings and any derived vectors the same as outputs; we will list them as a deletion category. Also: note that model fine-tune snapshots (none for ST-9182 per our catalog) would need separate review.

I’ll prepare an execution playbook (steps, owner, rollback, verification commands) and attach the playbook to the confirmation email.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Liu <andrea@stitchpay.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@stitchpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Execution plan and evidence delivery for ST-9182 purge

Andrea / team — attaching the execution playbook and the artifacts template we will populate as we run. High level: 
1) Pre-check: identify object sets (prompts, outputs, embeddings, logs).
2) Snapshot: take immutable snapshots of current indices (for audit only).
3) Deletion pass: remove records from cold store, flush KV caches, redact audit-log rows.
4) Verification: run verification queries and produce a redaction-log CSV.
5) Chain-of-custody: produce signed manifest + process log; we timestamp and store in a restricted Drive folder.

Estimated execution start: Tue 2027-05-31 15:00 PDT, duration ~6–10 hours. We will stream progress to the shared Drive folder and post the final sanitized evidence.

Attachments (included):
- erasure-steps-playbook-v2.docx (playbook with command list)
- redaction-log-20270530.csv (format stub)
- sanitization-evidence-20270530.pdf (example evidence template)

Please confirm sign-off by reply to this thread and indicate any additional legal/archival constraints.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Incident Response & Evidence | Redwood Inference

--
Evelyn Hart
redwood.ai
From: Andrea Liu <andrea@stitchpay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@stitchpay.com>, stitchpay-legal@stitchpay.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution plan and evidence delivery for ST-9182 purge

Thanks, Evelyn — approved to proceed on the timeline. A couple quick asks before you start: 
- Can you include a signed attestation (PDF) stating the exact scope and that no backups containing ST-9182 data will be retained beyond the scope?
- We need the chain-of-custody to include operator IDs and step timestamps.

If you can provide the attestation template, our legal team will countersign. Proceed when ready.

Andrea Liu
Head of Security Ops
StitchPay
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Liu <andrea@stitchpay.com>, stitchpay-legal@stitchpay.com
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation: ST-9182 purge scheduled and attestation path

Andrea / legal — confirmed: execution will start 2027-05-31 15:00 PDT as noted by Evelyn. Evelyn will deliver the redaction-log and signed manifest to the Drive folder at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1StitchPay-ErasureEvidence when complete. We will also upload a preliminary attestation template into that folder within 2 hours so your legal team can countersign.

Post-execution we will provide: 
- signed attestation PDF (Redwood signature + operator IDs)
- redaction-log CSV (object_id, deleted_at, operator_id)
- sanitization evidence PDF (hashes and verification queries)

If StitchPay needs a notarized or third-party witness option, flag it in reply and we will arrange procurement.

Thanks — Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
